description: This file defines a static utility class OrleansDebuggerHelper with a method to retrieve grain instances from grain references, primarily aiding debugger sessions within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: OrleansDebuggerHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to assist debugging by extracting grain instances from grain references.

methods.name: GetGrainInstance
methods.description: Returns the grain instance for a given grain reference if it is activated on the current silo; otherwise, returns null.
